article.story: COLUMBUS, Ohio -- — Justin Pippen scored 15 of his 17 points in the first half for Ohio State, and the Buckeyes built a 24-point halftime lead and cruised past UMBC 101-62 on Thursday night. John Mobley Jr. added 15 points for Ohio State (4-2). Mobley surpassed 1,000 career points on a dunk with about five minutes left. Amare Bynum had 14 points and matched a career-best with 10 rebounds for the Buckeyes. Pippen finished with four 3-pointers to go with seven assists and six rebounds. The Buckeyes shot 53% overall, hit 16 of 45 from long range and had nine dunks. Riley Jacobs scored 16 points and Evan Morton added 12 off the bench for UMBC (3-4). The Buckeyes had a double-digit lead seven minutes in and closed the first half on a 20-7 run for a 53-29 halftime advantage, shooting 61% from the field and 12 of 24 from distance. Ohio State is 12-1 against current teams in the America East Conference. The Buckeyes have won all four of their matchups against UMBC. Up next UMBC: hosts Lancaster Bible on Sunday. Ohio State: at home against No. 15 Vanderbilt on Tuesday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
